subject: Processing partner update (APAC): request for data flow diagram and controls
messages:
From: Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@sakurafinance.co.jp>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendor Ops <vendor.ops@nodalpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 23:12:00 +09:00
Subject: Notification: New APAC processing partner engaged for latency-sensitive routing

Hi Stephanie,

Quick heads up from Sakura Finance — we recently contracted Nodal Partners to provide edge routing and short‑term caching for Japanese region traffic. They will process token-level metadata (no raw PII) to improve latency for end-user inference. The onboarding legal package is attached.

Key points:
- Start date: 2027-03-20
- Data types: request metadata, region, model-id, partial prompt hashes
- Subcontracting: Nodal will retain a subcontractor for CDN in-country (details in appendix)

Can Redwood confirm whether this partner needs to be added to our processing partner roster and whether Sakura requires any additional evidence (data flow diagram, encryption at rest proofs, KMS key policies)? Keiko and I are looping in Vendor Ops for any technical diagrams.

Thanks,
Keiko
Keiko Tanaka
Head of Cloud Integrations | Sakura Finance
keiko.tanaka@sakurafinance.co.jp

Attachments: sakai_vendor_security-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), vendor_contract_excerpt.pdf (excerpt)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@sakurafinance.co.jp>, Vendor Ops <vendor.ops@nodalpartners.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notification: New APAC processing partner engaged for latency-sensitive routing

Hi Keiko — thanks for the notice and the attachments. Quick clarifying questions so we can route this internally to Security & Legal: 

1) Will Nodal receive any content that could include customer-provided secrets or API keys?
2) Will any data be transferred outside Japan/Asia as part of their processing chain? If yes, which specific third-party endpoints?
3) We usually provide a minimum evidence package: (a) data flow diagram, (b) encryption-at-rest screenshot and KMS policy excerpt, (c) SOC2 or ISO attestation. Can you confirm which of those Nodal can provide by 2027-03-18?

Looping in Rishi for procurement and Evelyn for security review. Rishi — can you confirm whether a formal roster addition and DPA amendment will be required for this engagement (Sakura is asking for timeline)? Evelyn — if you need additional artifacts, flag them and we’ll request from Nodal.

Best,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Office: +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Attachment referenced: apac_processing_partner_dataflow.pdf (pending from vendor)

From: Vendor Ops <vendor.ops@nodalpartners.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Keiko Tanaka <keiko.tanaka@sakurafinance.co.jp>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:07:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Notification: New APAC processing partner engaged for latency-sensitive routing

Hi Stephanie / Keiko,

Thanks — we can provide the items requested. Attached is a concise data flow diagram for the APAC routing path (apac_processing_partner_dataflow.pdf). Highlights:
- No customer API keys or secrets are stored by Nodal; transient tokens are hashed and dropped after routing decision is made.
- Primary processing occurs in Tokyo (ap-southeast-1 equivalent).
- Backup replication to Singapore is only for failover; no analytics exports to US.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; KMS: AWS KMS with customer-managed CMK available upon request.

We’ve also attached a short security summary spreadsheet and a redacted SOC attestations pack. Let us know if Sakura wants vendor-signed certs or additional logs.

Regards,
Alex Moreno
Head of Ops | Nodal Partners
vendor.ops@nodalpartners.com

Attachments: apac_processing_partner_dataflow.pdf (diagram), nodal_security_summary.pdf (summary)

Thanks all — reviewed the attachments. Quick internal notes and next steps: 

- Procurement: we will treat Nodal as a processing partner and add an exhibit to the Sakura DPA. I’ll prepare a roster addendum and send a redline to Legal by 2027-03-18. Deal ID HD-98432 will be updated.
- Security: Evelyn, thanks for the checklist. From our side we need a signed KMS policy excerpt or confirmation Redwood can manage CMK access controls for customer-key requests. If Nodal cannot provide a customer-managed CMK path, we need an alternative technical mitigation.
- Compliance: Since there is a replication hop to Singapore, we should record that in the transfer matrix and confirm contractual restrictions re: analytics exports to the US.

Action items:
1) Rishi to share roster addendum draft with Stephanie and Sakura by 2027-03-18.
2) Stephanie to confirm with Keiko whether Sakura needs vendor-signed certs or logs.
3) Evelyn to list any remaining artifacts required for SOC/ISO evidence (ETA 2027-03-19).

Rishi
